Maker figures: 170 cm, 20 humanoid DoF (7-DoF arms, 6-DoF hands, 3-DoF head), 300 Nm peak joint torque, 10 km/h running (2.78 m/s converted from the maker's km/h figure), dual 30 Ah + 3 Ah quick-swap packs, up to 550 TOPS expandable compute, optional depth camera, LiDAR, Orin board, 6-axis force/torque sensors and five-finger hands, open motor, sensor and motion-control interfaces; CNY 299,000.
